messages:
incidentbot: PagerDuty ALERT: PD-40021 triggered for service=hosted-inference-api (P1). Escalation: primary -> secondary -> manager. Primary page: @rachel, secondary: @tom. Link: https://pagerduty.example/PD-40021 :rotating_light: 

rachel: acked. i can see elevated tail latency on /v1/chat/stream in us-east-1 starting 03:05 UTC. no large error spike but p99 ~3.2s. investigating.

priya: any related deploys in the last hour? 

rachel: checked deploy bot - no recent release. looks correlated with a nodepool scaledown event at 02:58 UTC per autoscaler logs.

devops-bot: autoscaler: nodepool-inference: scaled down by 3 at 02:58 UTC (reason=utilization_threshold). API: https://console.example/k8s/nodepools

rachel: tailing runtime logs, grabbing kv cache eviction lines: `kubectl -n inference logs -l app=hosted-gen -c runtime --since=10m`

rachel: pasted:
```
[03:04:59] WARN runtime: KV_CACHE_EVICT shard=4 evicted_bytes=268435456 reason=scale_down
[03:05:01] INFO runtime: cache_miss model=gpt-13k shard=4 key=tenant:acct_9812:ctx_hash
[03:05:03] WARN runtime: cold-start latency model=gpt-13k init_ms=450
```

reminder: messages above are chronological and un-edited

tom: i'm traveling and missed initial page (DND). i'm online now. looks like evictions caused a burst of cold starts and some requests hit longer paths. if primary is on it, i'll stand by to help with scaling.

incidentbot: PagerDuty: secondary escalation fired (no ack from secondary within 5m). Manager @nina-manager paged at 03:10 UTC.

nina-manager: on call. will join bridge and assess. joining https://meet.example/INC-40021 :telephone_receiver:

rachel: mitigation proposal: 1) temporarily increase nodepool target by +5, 2) add a short-lived rate-limit for non-critical tenants to reduce cold-start fanout, 3) route enterprise customers to dedicated pool if we can.

priya: can we flip a traffic gate quickly? i can add a routing rule in the gateway: `curl -X POST https://gateway.example/rules -d '{"route":"/v1/chat/stream","filter":"tenant in (test1,test2) -> reduce qps by 50%"}'` (will validate).

rachel: scaling now via terraform run: `terraform apply -var='inference_nodes=+5' -auto-approve` (started).

devops-bot: terraform: apply started for module.inference_pool (plan id tx-9f3).

rachel: applying a short token-bucket limit for noisy tenants at the edge, pushing rule.

incidentbot: PagerDuty: manager acknowledged at 03:12 UTC. escalation halted.

tom: scale completed, new nodes joining. verifying pod readiness: `kubectl get pods -n inference -l app=hosted-gen -o wide` -> pods ready 12/12.

rachel: warmup job launched to prepopulate KV for top prefixes. job: jobs/prewarm-top-prefixes with param `--top=2000 --concurrency=8`. logs show warmup throughput ~300 keys/s.

priya: routing change applied and traffic to vulnerable tenants reduced ~40% within 60s. p99 dropping.

rachel: monitoring: p99 back to ~220ms within 6 minutes of scale. no 5xx seen. affected footprint: ~4% of overall traffic; two named enterprise tenants saw >2s for ~8 minutes.

nina-manager: thank you. i'm going to message accounts and ops with an initial note. avoid calling customers yet unless they ask.

rachel: incident timeline note for runbook:
- 02:58 autoscaler scaled down nodepool by 3
- 03:05 increase in KV eviction events and cache miss storm
- 03:06 PagerDuty PD-40021 fired
- 03:07 primary ack (rachel)
- 03:10 secondary escalation (tom missed due to DND), manager paged
- 03:12 manager ack (nina)
- 03:13 terraform scale started
- 03:16 runtime pods ready
- 03:17 prewarm job complete
- 03:22 p99 restored to baseline

priya: suggested action items: lower scale-down aggressiveness for inference nodepool; implement prewarm hook in autoscaler lifecycle so scaledown triggers a preservation window; add PD rule to delay manager escalation for transient latency spikes under X minutes; add alert for KV eviction rate > 30/min.

tom: i'll take the autoscaler tuning (INF-4302). rachel, can you take the prewarm automation and gate rule (INF-4303)?

rachel: assigned. creating tickets.

incidentbot: PagerDuty: PD-40021 status updated to "under investigation" and acknowledged. No further escalations. :white_check_mark:

nina-manager: nicely handled. please do a short blameless postmortem and include metric graphs. i'll review runbook changes before merge.

priya: i'll coordinate the brief customer note for the two affected tenants: "We observed elevated latency for a subset of inference requests around 03:05 UTC due to autoscaler scale-down and transient cache evictions. Service remained available; mitigations applied and latency restored. We're implementing autoscaler and prewarm changes to prevent recurrence."

rachel: wrapping up logs and adding final incident notes. closing thread after postmortem doc is linked. :thumbsup:
